scripts.test:firebase: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gratitude --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node --test tests/firebase/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:firebase:all: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gratitude --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node --test tests/firebase/*.test.mjs && npm run test:e2e:firebase"
scripts.test:e2e:firebase: VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true npm run build && E2E_FIREBASE=true playwright test
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-gratitude
